Experienced, pragmatic Rust agent; do not over-engineer; keep edits minimal. If you want an exception to ANY rule, you MUST stop and get permission first.

This repo is a complete Rust rewrite of Coder, targeting full backend route/behavior parity with `https://github.com/coder/coder`. Progress: 72/229 OSS routes; `docs/parity-matrix.md` is the status source of truth. `coder/` is a read-only Go reference submodule; after cloning, run `git submodule update --init coder` if empty. **NEVER modify any file under `coder/`** — it is read-only reference material  
**NEVER commit changes to `coder/`**  
Rust work goes in `crates/` and `apps/`. Reference handlers in `coder/coderd/*.go`, SDK models in `coder/codersdk/*.go`, queries in `coder/coderd/database/queries/*.sql`, models in `coder/coderd/database/*.go`, migrations in `coder/coderd/database/migrations/`.

For a missing route: find it in `docs/parity-matrix.md`; read its Go handler, SDK models, SQL queries; define Rust types/models in `coder-core` or feature crate; port storage/migrations to `coder-db`; implement handler in `coder-server` or feature crate; add in-file `#[cfg(test)]` tests; validate with `cargo fmt --all && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets && cargo test`.

Rust 2024, MSRV 1.85, toolchain 1.94.0; Axum 0.8, PostgreSQL/sqlx 0.8, Tokio, serde, custom auth, tracing, reqwest/rustls, AGPL-3.0-only. Crates: `coder-core` shared types; `coder-server` HTTP; `coder-db`; `coder-auth`; `coder-identity`; `coder-rbac`; `coder-audit`; `coder-workspaces`; `coder-provisioner`; `coder-connectivity`; `coder-notifications`. Main files: `crates/coder-server/src/app.rs`, `crates/coder-server/src/error.rs`, `crates/coder-db/src/store.rs`, `crates/coder-core/src/ports.rs`, `crates/coder-core/src/api.rs`, `crates/coder-core/src/config.rs`, `apps/coderd/src/main.rs`, `docs/parity-matrix.md`, `docs/backend-rewrite.md`.

All dependencies are declared in the root `Cargo.toml` under `[workspace.dependencies]`. **Do not** add dependency versions in individual crate `Cargo.toml` files. Workspace lints:
`unwrap_used = "deny"` — Use `?` or explicit error handling, never `.unwrap()`
`expect_used = "deny"` — Same; no `.expect()` either
`panic = "deny"` — No `panic!()`
`todo = "deny"` — No `todo!()` macros
`dbg_macro = "deny"` — No `dbg!()` left in code
`unsafe_code = "forbid"` — No `unsafe` blocks at all
`unreachable_pub = "warn"`; `unused_qualifications = "warn"`.
Use `thiserror` for defining error enums. Propagate with `?`. Never use `.unwrap()` or `.expect()`.
**No `.unwrap()` / `.expect()` / `panic!()` / `todo!()` / `dbg!()`** — The workspace denies these at the lint level. CI and `cargo clippy` will reject them.
**No `unsafe` code** — Forbidden workspace-wide.
**No per-crate dependency versions** — Always use `workspace = true` references.
**Do not modify files under `coder/`** — This is the vendored Go reference. Treat as read-only.
**Do not create separate `tests/` directories** — Use `#[cfg(test)]` in-file.

Validation:
1. `cargo fmt --all` — Format all code.
2. `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` — Must pass with zero warnings.
3. `cargo test` — All tests must pass.
4. `cargo build` — Ensure clean compilation.
Other commands: `cargo run --bin coderd`; `cargo fmt --all -- --check`; `cargo run -p coder-parity -- inventory --go-root coder --rust-root . --scope oss --output docs/parity-matrix.md`; `cargo test -p coder-server`.

Handlers are in `crates/coder-server/src/app.rs`; follow existing extractor, JSON response, and error-mapping patterns. Commit format: `type: message` (`feat`, `fix`, `refactor`, `docs`, `test`, `chore`); explain what changed and why, reference Go routes, and update `apps/coder-parity` when adding routes.
